items.title: The infinitesimal lifting condition for formally etale morphisms of algebraic spaces needs no affineness
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that in the lifting characterisation of formal etaleness for morphisms of algebraic spaces the test thickenings need not be affine: any first order thickening of schemes over the base admits exactly one lift. The proof covers the thickening by affine pieces, applies the affine form of the condition on each piece, and then glues the resulting lifts using uniqueness to see that the pieces agree on overlaps. Gluing the local lifts and using uniqueness to force agreement is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 3563-3573.
